findings.observedBoundary: Zero-retry CLI absence formatting must be matched by exact operation/code, not converted into a permission or connectivity pass.
findings.futureAcceptance: Extract a pure absence-envelope rule; replay malformed, multiple-error, nonempty stdout, positive retry and wrong-operation cases through each new adapter.

findings.observedBoundary: Plan resource changes and state addresses are different sets; managed and data addresses need separate classification.
findings.futureAcceptance: Derive per-run managed/data sets and allowed data definitions from reviewed state and inputs. Never copy the incident-specific seven-address exception into prod.

findings.observedBoundary: ESO ready workloads could not patch a deleting ExternalSecret after namespace-scoped RBAC was removed. Interruption exposed the wait but did not create this ordering dependency.
findings.futureAcceptance: Add a controller/RBAC dependency fixture: keep ESO permissions until dependent ExternalSecrets finish; unknown finalizers stop; no generic force-finalizer option.

findings.observedBoundary: Targeted EKS destruction included reviewed dependents outside module.eks. Prefix-only rejection was too narrow.
findings.futureAcceptance: Common gate must compare exact reviewed addresses, definitions and before IDs, managed drift and action sets. Fifty deletes is historical test data, not a universal count.

findings.observedBoundary: EKS Terraform deletion completed before an available unattached interface blocked the orphan security-group guard; independently approved cleanup completed later.
findings.futureAcceptance: Add saved-snapshot ENI continuation fixtures for attachment, requester management, owner, VPC/subnet, public association, references, disappearance and once-only deletion. Do not introduce detach or auto-repair.

findings.observedBoundary: Active instant request history is not evidence that launched instances still exist. Native exact captured-instance absence remains required.
findings.futureAcceptance: Reuse the pure classifier with explicit environment inputs, then perform fresh uncached native ID checks in each adapter. Active maintain/request and live instances fail.

findings.observedBoundary: Expired proofs and consumed markers require a newly reviewed session; changing main or resuming cannot renew an old saved plan.
findings.futureAcceptance: Extract clock/input/phase validation and exclusive journal rules. Transport failures and timeouts preserve a consumed attempt; continuation is a separate reviewed operation.

proposedCoreInterfaces.name: EnvironmentProfile
proposedCoreInterfaces.responsibility: Explicit account/region/cluster/state/release/DNS bindings; no default dev fallback and no inherited prod authorization.

proposedCoreInterfaces.name: ReviewProof
proposedCoreInterfaces.responsibility: Exact input bytes, main, state, phase, TTL and execution deadline; unchanged saved-plan creation clock.

proposedCoreInterfaces.name: ServiceObservation
proposedCoreInterfaces.responsibility: Pure strict JSON and native absence/type/ownership rules; transport cannot grant scope or permission.

proposedCoreInterfaces.name: PlanScope
proposedCoreInterfaces.responsibility: Exact reviewed managed definitions, addresses, IDs and dependency closure; separate data and remote absence.

proposedCoreInterfaces.name: CleanupDependencies
proposedCoreInterfaces.responsibility: Keep controllers and scoped permissions while dependent objects/finalizers drain; phase receipts record only confirmed completion.

proposedCoreInterfaces.name: AttemptJournal
proposedCoreInterfaces.responsibility: Exclusive attempt reservation, write-ahead mutation stages and redacted failure plus durable raw logs; no implicit retry.

migrationSequence: Extract pure clock/phase/error/state rules into new modules with offline parity tests; leave frozen historical executors and contracts unchanged.
Implement dependency-aware cleanup planning and captured ENI/SG continuation with explicit approvals and new coverage for both gaps.
Add explicit environment adapters and shared fake-transport replay; compare dev/test/prod configuration without enabling live prod.
Review immutable release, current price/budget, fresh main/account/state and independent prod design before any separately approved live operation.
scopeLimits: No all-region or untagged exhaustive inventory conclusion
No test qualification or prod readiness certification
No raw private inputs or credential values inspected
